# frozen_string_literal: true

# Encodes how a reusable Ruby gem is built, packaged, and released: the
# Bundler/RubyGems skeleton command, the split between runtime and
# development dependencies, a consumer require check that runs outside
# any application boot, the files that are safe to package, and the
# authorization boundary in front of publishing. The advisor describes
# these steps; it never builds or publishes anything itself.
class RubyGemDevelopmentAdvisor
  # Paths that must never ship inside the package: the test suite,
  # local secrets, repository metadata, and generated artifacts.
  PACKAGE_EXCLUDED_PREFIXES = [
    "test/",
    "spec/",
    ".env",
    ".git/",
    "coverage/",
    "pkg/",
    "log/"
  ].freeze

  # A new gem skeleton comes from Bundler so the generated gemspec,
  # Rakefile, and test layout follow the standard layout.
  def skeleton_command(name)
    "bundle gem #{name}"
  end

  # Runtime dependencies load when the gem is required; development
  # dependencies exist only to develop and test the gem itself.
  def dependency_groups
    {
      "runtime" => ["json"],
      "development" => ["minitest", "rake"]
    }
  end

  # The consumer check loads the gem the way a downstream application
  # would: a plain ruby process with no application boot, so a broken
  # require path fails here instead of in production.
  def consumer_require_command(gem_name)
    "ruby -e 'require \"#{gem_name}\"'"
  end

  # Only files that belong to the package contract are safe to ship.
  # Test files, credentials, and repository or build artifacts stay out.
  def safe_package_files(files)
    files.reject do |file|
      PACKAGE_EXCLUDED_PREFIXES.any? { |prefix| file.start_with?(prefix) }
    end
  end

  # Publishing is a separate, explicitly authorized step. Readiness can
  # be verified without it; a release without authorization is refused.
  def release_allowed?(authorized:)
    authorized ? true : false
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "minitest/autorun"
require_relative "../lib/solution"

class RubyGemDevelopmentAdvisorTest < Minitest::Test
  def setup
    @advisor = RubyGemDevelopmentAdvisor.new
  end

  def test_uses_bundle_gem_for_skeleton
    assert_equal "bundle gem fixture_gem",
                 @advisor.skeleton_command("fixture_gem")
  end

  def test_separates_runtime_and_development_dependencies
    assert_equal(
      { "runtime" => ["json"], "development" => ["minitest", "rake"] },
      @advisor.dependency_groups
    )
  end

  def test_tests_consumer_require_path_outside_application_boot
    assert_equal(
      "ruby -e 'require \"fixture_gem\"'",
      @advisor.consumer_require_command("fixture_gem")
    )
  end

  def test_excludes_secrets_and_test_artifacts_from_package
    assert_equal(
      [
        "Gemfile",
        "fixture_gem.gemspec",
        "lib/fixture_gem.rb",
        "lib/fixture_gem/version.rb"
      ],
      @advisor.safe_package_files(
        [
          "Gemfile",
          "fixture_gem.gemspec",
          "lib/fixture_gem.rb",
          "lib/fixture_gem/version.rb",
          "test/test_fixture_gem.rb",
          ".env",
          ".git/config"
        ]
      )
    )
  end

  def test_release_requires_explicit_authorization
    refute @advisor.release_allowed?(authorized: false)
    assert @advisor.release_allowed?(authorized: true)
  end

  def test_skeleton_command_tracks_the_requested_name
    assert_equal "bundle gem invoicing_core",
                 @advisor.skeleton_command("invoicing_core")
  end

  def test_package_excludes_generated_artifacts_and_local_state
    assert_equal(
      ["lib/fixture_gem.rb"],
      @advisor.safe_package_files(
        [
          "lib/fixture_gem.rb",
          "coverage/.resultset.json",
          "pkg/fixture_gem-0.1.0.gem",
          "log/test.log",
          "spec/fixture_gem_spec.rb"
        ]
      )
    )
  end

  def test_consumer_require_command_stays_boot_independent
    assert_equal "ruby -e 'require \"invoicing_core\"'",
                 @advisor.consumer_require_command("invoicing_core")
  end
end
